title: Children in Horse-Drawn Sleigh, 1920s Winter Sepia Snapshot Photo
description: A charming vintage sepia-toned snapshot depicting two young children bundled up in winter coats and hats, seated in a horse-drawn sleigh or cutter cart in a snowy rural landscape. A pinto horse is harnessed in the foreground. The reverse side features a diamond logo stamp reading SELBRO and a purple number 8.
